body:
Review corrections pushed at `d1c9074e9e6654fe77474571d7dc5e078a857c0a`.

Completed: shared controlled typed classification/routing execution; cancellation preserving usage and owner fences; narrow ModelControl identity/version; checked permission JSON reuse; restored-ACP permission observation before private-file reads; complete PTY daemon shutdown checks; local IPC/PTY/projection setup simplification.

Current-source local verification: **4,758 workspace tests passed, 24 skipped, no reported LEAKs or source drift**. Also 33 focused regressions, one five-case ACP recovery matrix plus four actual Goal PTY scenarios, strict all-target/all-feature Clippy, fmt, 6 doctests (1 ignored), generated artifacts, SDK default build and orchestrator without ACP features.

[Latest corrections, source manifest and reproduction](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/blob/d1c9074e9e6654fe77474571d7dc5e078a857c0a/docs/evidence/bro-goal-workflow/2026-10-16-review-fixes.md). The 999-file source manifest digest is `70c49f6ecf71312e1ae078f19d30a9e6ebfb28593af0d1b8d13b2958d21f7177`.

Hosted verification is **still in progress** at this exact head. The Linux native-goals shard passed 212 tests (6 skipped), including all four Goal PTY scenarios; platform Clippy and feature isolation passed. Remaining full/platform tests and Rust analysis are not yet qualified.

A separate evidence annex is being prepared with original failed attempts, passing logs, available patches, the source recovery bundle and three local Cargo-built fixture executable files. This comment will pin its immutable commit after hosted checks finish. Previous CI-inclusive evidence stays at [c0b75b14](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/tree/c0b75b141b3041a1cd9c1284aa16acc27caaab79), with earlier archives unchanged.

Actual vendor harness/provider requalification remains **unpassed**. Fixture files are not process/memory images or hosted filesystem exports. Core persistence migration, complete Turn-fixed routing, graph editing and Goal owner handoff remain deferred. PR remains open and unmerged.
